wiki.title: Katherine Kazarian
wiki.extract: Katherine S. Kazarian (born June 25, 1990 in East Providence, Rhode Island) is an American politician and a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives representing District 63 since January 1, 2013. She became House Majority Whip in January 2021, and became the first woman to serve as House Majority Leader on May 7, 2026.
